title: Email body shows [object Promise] after upgrading React Email
symptoms: Recipients receive the literal text [object Promise]
html field is a Promise in logs
renderAsync is not exported after upgrading
cause: render became async in @react-email/render 1.0.0 and renderAsync was removed in 2.0.0. Code that passes render() straight into html sends the Promise.
fix: Await render, or pass the component through the react field and let the SDK render it.
apply: const html = await render(<WelcomeEmail name={name} />); await resend.emails.send({ from, to, subject, html });
